quests.title: Returns at Juniors Kingsford
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. I am sending back 49 papers a day from Juniors Kingsford and paying to have them collected, which is a business model somebody invented on purpose. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: the returns stack, at its worst
the distributor needs to see the size of it

quests.title: The Better Rate, Juniors Kingsford
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. They will drop my Juniors Kingsford order if I can show $61 of turnover on the other side of the shop by a public holiday nobody remembered. You will see what I mean the second you get there. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: $61, and cards and stationery count
sell anything, I am not proud

quests.title: The Juniors Kingsford Round
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. I do the Juniors Kingsford round from the second express and for the last fortnight somebody has been taking the papers off the front steps behind me. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: the end of the round, where it starts
whoever is on that street at that hour

quests.title: The Dog on Ash Street, Juniors Kingsford
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. There is a dog on the Juniors Kingsford round that has had two of my bags and a folding table that was not even mine. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: you will want your wits about you
the owner, not the dog, I am not a monster
tell me it is sorted

quests.title: The Syndicate, Juniors Kingsford
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. Nine of us at Juniors Kingsford have gone in on the same numbers since a public holiday nobody remembered and one of us has stopped putting money in. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: the house of the one who stopped
$49, which is his share since he stopped
I want it said out loud, not in the group chat

quests.title: The Other Agency, Juniors Kingsford
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. The agency at UNSW Anzac Parade closed six months before Juniors Kingsford started struggling, and I would very much like to know what they know. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: the shop is shut, the family is not
whatever they say, say it slowly to me
